subject: Post-discovery: VP/CTO intro + follow-up tech deep dive
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@retailco.com>, Tom Bennett <tbennett@retailco.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 02 Aug 2025 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: VP/CTO intro + follow-up tech deep dive

Hi Alicia / Tom —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps to keep momentum: 

Summary of what we heard
- Pilot goal: reduce per-token inference cost by ~30% while matching current LLM quality for product recommendations.
- Key constraints: PII routing requirements, VPC-only deployment for certain customer data flows, and SLA target of 99.9% for peak hours.
- Decision makers: Alicia (SaaS Platform Lead), Tom (Infrastructure), and the CTO for final sign-off.

Proposed next steps (two short meetings):
1) VP/CTO intro (30m) — executive handshake to confirm success criteria and procurement runway.
2) Technical deep dive (60m) — infra runbook, latency/throughput targets, security checklist (VPC/KMS), and run of our mutual action plan (MAP).

Availability I can offer next week (Pacific):
- Tue 8/5 10:00–10:30 or 14:00–14:30
- Wed 8/6 11:00–11:30
- Thu 8/7 09:00–09:30 or 16:00–16:30

For the tech deep dive we propose a 1-hour slot the week after the exec handshake; we’ll bring: Karthik (infra lead), Marissa (solutions/CS), and a short pre-read (MAP draft attached).

Attachments: RetailCo_MAP_draft.pdf (draft mutual action plan), SOW_template.docx (procurement starter).

Ask: please confirm a preferred exec-handshake slot and who from your side will join the VP/CTO call (CTO name / procurement lead). Once we lock that I’ll send an invite and hold a 1-hour technical slot the following week.

Best,
Jordan
Senior Sales Lead | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Thanks Jordan — helpful recap and the MAP looks good as a starting point.

We’re aligned to move forward. For the VP/CTO intro, two possible slots that work for our CTO (Vikram Patel) and Tom:
- Wed 8/6 14:30–15:00 PT
- Thu 8/7 09:00–09:30 PT

Prefer Wed 8/6 if that works for your team. For attendees from our side: Vikram (CTO), Tom (Infra), myself (Platform).

We’ll need a short agenda (5 min goals + 20 min open discussion + 5 min next steps) so the CTO can be efficient with his time. Also can you attach a one-page latency/throughput snapshot we can share with Vikram beforehand?

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 05 Aug 2025 08:16:00 -0700
Subject: Re: internal: prep for RetailCo tech deep dive (agenda + asks)

Jordan / Marissa — I’ll join Wed 8/6 for the exec intro. For the 60m tech deep dive (proposed week of 8/11) I suggest this agenda and pre-reqs so we have an efficient session: 

Proposed 60m technical agenda (deep dive)
- 0–5m: Quick context and success criteria (Alicia)
- 5–20m: Runtime + model variant choices (Karthik) — quantization options, expected latency delta, memory footprint
- 20–35m: Network & security (Marissa) — VPC peering, private egress, KMS/HSM keyflow
- 35–50m: Scaling and SLOs — autoscaling headroom, warm KV cache expectations, burst strategy
- 50–60m: Pilot gating checklist & next actions

Pre-reqs from RetailCo to make the call concrete:
- SLO targets (p99 / 95 latency) and peak QPS estimate
- Any redlines in data residency / retention policies
- A short list of representative prompts / largest prompt sizes (so we can show computed cost impact)

I’ll prepare the one-pager Jordan asked for (95p latency, pilot QPS, pilot cost estimate) and a short appendix on quantization strategy. Marissa — can you surface our VPC onboarding doc link and permission matrix?

Karthik
Director, Inference Eng | Redwood Inference
From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@retailco.com>

Jordan / team — Wed 8/6 14:30 PT confirmed for the VP/CTO intro — invite sent (exec-intro-invite.ics attached). Vikram, Tom, and I will attend; please include the one-pager in the invite.

For the 60m tech deep dive week of 8/11, Tom will push a Doodle this afternoon with three 1-hour options (we prefer mornings PT). We’ll also attach our SLO targets and a short sample prompt set to the Doodle notes so you have that ahead of time.

Two quick asks before Wed:
- Can you circulate a redline-friendly PDF of the MAP (we’ll share internally with procurement)?
- If possible, a short note on any data retention options you support (default retention, short-term logs, and audit log export cadence).

Thanks — looking forward to the call.
Alicia
